key_facts.note: Same studio as the TV series

The distance between two people lying to each other matters more here than the speed of the fights.
It reads in order for viewers who know either the manga or the series.

encyclopedia.summary: A girl carrying an egg and a soldier wandering a ruined world walk together and say almost nothing. Mamoru Oshii's 1985 OVA builds its religious imagery out of pictures and sound alone, and it is one of the starting points for the director who would make Ghost in the Shell.
highlights: Meaning comes from repeated images rather than plot.
Its world borrows the ark and the idea of sacrifice.
The themes of memory and the body that Oshii would keep returning to are already here.

related.note: A later anime using the same religious imagery
